I am old now, 81 years, and I have worked this land all my life like my father before me. This small maize plot is just a little piece near the house, less than a quarter of a timad, so I do not buy a whole sack of fertilizer for it — one sack is too much and costs too much money. I will put the manure from my cattle on it like always, use the seed I saved from last year's harvest, and my sons and their wives will help me weed and harvest. I am too old to carry water, and the rains come in their time.
